clauses.text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the
laws of the United States of America, including the Federal Advisory Commit-
tee Act, as amended (5 U.S.C. App.), and to facilitate the work of the
Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy, it is
hereby ordered that Executive Order 12964 of June 21, 1995, as amended
by Executive Order 12987 of January 31, 1996, is further amended in section
2 by deleting in the first sentence ‘‘December 31, 1996’’ and inserting ‘‘Feb-
ruary 28, 1997’’ in lieu thereof.
œ–

Executive Order 13032 of December 26, 1996
Further Amendment to Executive Order No. 12964
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the
laws of the United States of America, including the Federal Advisory Commit-
tee Act, as amended (5 U.S.C. App.), and to facilitate the work of the
Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy, it is
hereby ordered that Executive Order 12964 of June 21, 1995, as amended
by Executive Order 12987 of January 31, 1996, is further amended in section
2 by deleting in the first sentence ‘‘December 31, 1996’’ and inserting ‘‘Feb-
ruary 28, 1997’’ in lieu thereof.
œ–
THE WHITE HOUSE,
December 26, 1996.
[FR Doc. 96–33336
Filed 12–27–96; 10:25 am]

versions.research_rationale: EO 13032 (signed 1996-12-26, 61 FR 68985, held official FR text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13032.txt read in full) has one operative sentence: it further amends EO 12964 of June 21, 1995 (Commission on United States-Pacific Trade and Investment Policy), as amended by EO 12987, in section 2 by deleting 'December 31, 1996' and inserting 'February 28, 1997'. Reading EO 12964 (60 FR 33095) and EO 12987 (61 FR 4205) in full shows that this is the report deadline in sec. 2(a). The dossier's single clause covers the whole operative text. Rulings applied: strike-and-insert (the amended clause continues with the parent until the parent ends), report deadline (a report deadline is never an end; the report-relative sunset in EO 12964 sec. 4, 'terminate 30 days after submitting its final report', is read the same way and recorded as functionally spent), unnamed instruments (the end is the instrument that names the order). Ending: EO 13062 of September 29, 1997 (62 FR 51755; held text offsets 3582-3967) sec. 3(b) revokes 'Executive Order 12964, as amended by Executive Orders 12987 and 13032', naming this order; sec. 7 (offsets 5353-5402) makes the order effective September 30, 1997, so the first and whole-order end is 1997-09-30, not the signing date. The dossier gap 'target provision not located: EO:13062' is closed by reading the held EO 13062 text: the machine record ACT:EO:13032>EO:13062 marks names_target false only because 13032 appears as an amender, but the revoking sentence prints the number. D6: the dossier chain lists only EO 13062; the draft's later-event proposals list nothing else; the OFR catalog search reports no other action; the by-number scan of 6,652 held FR texts finds 13032 only in EO 13032 and EO 13062. Functionally spent: EO 13062 sec. 3 says the Commission had terminated and its work was completed; the date of its final report (and so of its sec. 4 termination) is not held and is disclosed here rather than attached. No conflicts were listed by the draft. Savings: none_after_bounded_search. AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification and not a status.

savings_residuals.reason: EO 13062 (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13062.txt, 62 FR 51755-51756, read in full, offsets 0-5507): secs. 1-2 continue other committees, sec. 3 revokes the listed orders, secs. 4-6 supersede EO 12974 and amend EOs 13038 and 13054, sec. 7 sets the effective date. Its only 'Notwithstanding' wording (sec. 2) concerns the FACA functions for the committees continued in sec. 1; it has no savings, pending-matter, transfer or 'shall not affect' wording for revoked orders. EO 13032 (read in full) only changes a report date in EO 12964; it created no office, fund, property or private right, and EO 12964 (read in full, 60 FR 33095-33096) has no savings clause either. Nothing of the order outlives the revocation. Bounded search: these three held FR texts read in full; by-number scan of the 6,652 held FR order texts; the three machine searches (OFR catalog, U.S. Code, eCFR), which report no current-law hit for this order.

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: whole: the order's single operative sentence further amends sec. 2 of EO 12964 (as amended by EO 12987) by deleting 'December 31, 1996' in the first sentence and inserting 'February 28, 1997' (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13032.txt offsets 694-1246). The amended sentence is EO 12964 sec. 2(a), the Commission's report deadline (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12964.txt offsets 1900-1975: 'On or before February 1, 1996, the Commission shall report to the President'; changed by EO 12987, jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12987.txt offsets 1196-1220, to 'about December 31, 1996,'). Under the strike-and-insert ruling (2026-10-21) the amended clause continues, amended, until the parent order ends; under the report-deadline ruling a report deadline is never an end, and EO 12964 sec. 4 ('The Commission shall terminate 30 days after submitting its final report.', EO_12964.txt offsets 5393-5466) is a report-relative sunset that the same ruling reads as a spent fact, not an end. The order has no term or sunset of its own. First end: EO 13062 sec. 3(b), which names EO 13032 expressly, effective 1997-09-30 (sec. 7). No other instrument amended, extended or ended this clause before then (D6: by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR order texts finds 13032 only in EO 13032 and EO 13062; the EO 14309 hit is a SHA-256 digest). Functionally spent: the report date and the Commission's termination date are not held; EO 13062 sec. 3 ('have terminated and whose work is completed', EO_13062.txt offsets 3655-3698) states the Commission had terminated and its work was completed by September 29, 1997. This is disclosed, not attached as a later event, because no held source states the date.
